title: Chest Furnace
description: its so fast that the coal is shocked.
body:
Adds a multipurpose chest/furnace block. Currently only smelts copper and iron, but does it very quickly! Requires coal or charcoal for fuel!

Craft with 1x Chest 4x Blast Furnace and 4x Amethyst Shard
![Craft with 1x Chest 4x Blast Furnace and 4x Amethyst Shard](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/088b3818734d2d8f4d8bc3c9c3096f6c3bf45812.png)
